rules.title: Console copy operations are disabled
rules.rationale: Clipboard sharing between console and guest can leak sensitive data.

mitigation.summary: Set isolation.tools.copy.disable = TRUE (or remove the override).

rules.title: Console paste operations are disabled
rules.rationale: Pasting into the guest bypasses guest input controls.

mitigation.summary: Set isolation.tools.paste.disable = TRUE (or remove the override).

rules.title: Console drag-and-drop is disabled
rules.rationale: Drag-and-drop can move files across the console boundary.

mitigation.summary: Set isolation.tools.dnd.disable = TRUE (or remove the override).

rules.title: Console GUI options are disabled
rules.rationale: GUI options enable copy/paste features between guest and console.

rules.title: Virtual disk shrinking is disabled
rules.rationale: Guest-initiated shrink operations can cause denial of service on the datastore.

rules.title: Virtual disk wiping is disabled
rules.rationale: Guest-initiated wipe operations can cause denial of service on the datastore.

rules.title: Only one remote console connection is permitted
rules.rationale: Multiple concurrent console sessions allow a second user to observe an administrator's session.

rules.title: VMX informational message size is limited
rules.rationale: Unbounded guest-to-VMX messages can fill the datastore.

rules.title: Host information is not sent to guests
rules.rationale: Host performance details help an attacker in the guest plan further attacks.

rules.title: Number of retained VM log files is limited
rules.rationale: Unbounded log retention can exhaust datastore space.

rules.title: VM log file size is limited
rules.rationale: Unbounded log growth can exhaust datastore space.

rules.title: Guest cannot connect or disconnect devices
rules.rationale: Unprivileged guest users could connect removable devices or disconnect network adapters.

rules.title: Hardware 3D acceleration is disabled
rules.rationale: 3D acceleration increases the host attack surface reachable from the guest.

rules.title: No floppy devices are present
rules.rationale: Unneeded virtual devices increase attack surface.

steps: Power off, VM > Edit Settings > remove Floppy drive

rules.title: No CD/DVD devices are connected
rules.rationale: Connected media can introduce untrusted content.

steps: VM > Edit Settings > CD/DVD drive > uncheck Connected / Connect at power on

rules.title: No serial ports are present
rules.rationale: Serial ports, especially network-backed, provide an unmonitored channel into the guest.

mitigation.summary: Remove serial ports, or use secure network backing (telnets/ssl) with an exception.
steps: Power off, VM > Edit Settings > remove Serial port

rules.title: No parallel ports are present
rules.rationale: Unneeded virtual devices increase attack surface.

steps: Power off, VM > Edit Settings > remove Parallel port

rules.title: No USB controllers or devices are present
rules.rationale: USB passthrough allows data exfiltration and malicious device attachment.

steps: Power off, VM > Edit Settings > remove USB controller

rules.title: No PCI/PCIe passthrough devices
rules.rationale: Direct hardware access bypasses hypervisor isolation and can enable DMA attacks.

mitigation.summary: Remove passthrough devices or document an exception (e.g. GPU for AI workloads).

rules.title: Independent non-persistent disks are not used
rules.rationale: Non-persistent disks discard attacker activity and forensic evidence at power-off.

steps: VM > Edit Settings > Hard disk > Disk Mode

rules.title: No snapshots older than 7 days
rules.rationale: Aged snapshots grow unbounded, degrade performance and are often mistaken for backups.

mitigation.summary: Consolidate or delete aged snapshots after confirming backups.

rules.title: VMware Tools is current or supported
rules.rationale: Outdated Tools carry known vulnerabilities (e.g. SAML token and authentication bypass advisories).

steps: Upgrade via vSphere Lifecycle Manager or guest package manager

rules.title: VM uses UEFI firmware with Secure Boot
rules.rationale: Secure Boot prevents unsigned bootloaders and kernel rootkits in the guest.

mitigation.summary: Use EFI firmware and enable Secure Boot (guest OS support required).
steps: VM > Edit Settings > VM Options > Boot Options

rules.title: VM is encrypted
rules.rationale: VM encryption protects disks and memory files at rest, including in backups and on stolen media.

mitigation.summary: Configure a key provider and apply a VM encryption storage policy.
steps: VM > VM Policies > Edit VM Storage Policies

rules.title: dvfilter network API access is authorized

check.guidance: Review ethernetN.filterN.name entries; only approved security appliances may attach dvfilters

rules.rationale: Unauthorized dvfilters can inspect VM traffic.
